title.zh: 将西米萨米斯省Calamba的附属中学分离改设为Calamba国立综合中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Calamba Annex High School Situated in the Municipality of Calamba, From the Looc Nationalized High School Situated in the Municipality of Plaridel, All in the Province of Misamis Occidental, Into a Separate and Independent National High School to Be Known as the Calamba National Comprehensive High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Calamba Annex High School Situated in the Municipality of Calamba, From the Looc Nationalized High School Situated in the Municipality of Plaridel, All in the Province of Misamis Occidental, Into a Separate and Independent National High School to Be Known as the Calamba National Comprehensive High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7780_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Calamba Annex High School situated in the Municipality or Calamba is hereby separated from the Looc Nationalized High School situated in the Municipality of Plaridel, independently, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, and be known as the Calamba National Comprehensive High School.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be funded out of the appropriations authorized by Republic Act No. 7663 for the Department of Education, Culture and Sports intended for the operational expenses of newly legislated high schools. Thereafter, the amount needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
